einzeiler: Astrologer Aliza Kelly joins the podcast to explore the cosmic connections of the Axeman…
kurzfassung: The hosts and astrologer Aliza Kelly examine the historical and astrological patterns behind the chilling murders committed by the Axeman of New Orleans. They discuss the striking parallels between the 1918-1919 attacks, the Spanish flu pandemic, and other notorious criminal cases through an astrological lens. The conversation highlights key suspects, bizarre details like the infamous jazz letter, and the ultimate poetic justice that ended the killer's reign.
stichpunkte: Aliza Kelly returns for the annual October special to discuss the Axeman of New Orleans.
The hosts explore uncanny parallels between the Axeman attacks and the 2020 pandemic timeline.
Early attacks dating back to 1910 share similarities involving meat cleavers and grocery store owners.
The Axeman's signature method involved chiseling through the bottom panels of wooden doors.
Astrological charts reveal recurring signatures like the 22-degree point and rare planetary oppositions.
The infamous 1919 letter from the Axeman demanded that residents play jazz music to be spared.
Strong suspect Frank Doc Mumphrey provides a compelling link to the decade-long reign of terror.
The terrifying spree finally came to an end when a victim's widow shot the prime suspect in Los Angeles.

clips.hook: An eerie alignment between the 1918 flu outbreak and the 2020 pandemic
clips.text: The speaker points out that the exact date the influenza broke out in 1918 coincided with the declaration of the pandemic in 2020.

clips.hook: A criminal who took an extortion scheme way too far
clips.text: The hosts consider whether the killer was an operative in an extortion ring who went rogue and escalated threats into actual murders.

clips.hook: A demonic letter demanding jazz music to spare lives
clips.text: A reading from the killer's letter reveals a bizarre ultimatum that households playing jazz music on a specific night will be spared from the axe.

clips.hook: Connecting the Axeman letter to the Saturn return of Jack the Ripper
clips.text: The astrological analysis reveals that the Axeman's letter occurred precisely during the 30-year Saturn return cycle following Jack the Ripper's letters.

clips.hook: Poetic justice when a widow tracks down and kills the suspect
clips.text: The decades-long mystery concludes when a grieving widow recognizes her late husband's attacker years later in California and shoots him dead.

beschreibung:
Spooky Season wouldn’t be complete without a visit from astrologer, author, and friend Aliza Kelly! She takes us on a cosmic deep dive to unravel another of history’s most chilling mysteries: the Axeman of New Orleans! We discuss the killer’s reign of terror, the haunting details surrounding the case, and how astrology offers cosmic perspective on this dark chapter in history.
Want to hang out more with Aliza? Check out her podcast AstroloTea with Aliza Kelly: Horoscopes and Astrology
Are you going to be near San Francisco on October 28th? Get tickets to Aliza Kelly's Haunted Tea Party! It's going to be iconic!
